docs.title: Commands
docs.text:
• mkdocs new [dir-name] - Create a new project.
  • mkdocs serve - Start the live-reloading docs server.
  • mkdocs build - Build the documentation site.
  • mkdocs -h - Print help message and exit.

docs.title: Case Study: High-Performance Asynchronous Message Board API
docs.text:
A production-grade, fully asynchronous microservice built to demonstrate modern backend engineering paradigms, strict payload validation, and containerized lifecycle management.

sequenceDiagram
    autonumber
    actor Client as Client / Swagger UI
    participant API as FastAPI Application
    participant Auth as JWT Auth Guard
    participant DB as SQLite (via aiosqlite)

    Client->>API: POST /login (Username/Password)
    API->>DB: Query User & Verify Bcrypt Hash
    DB-->>API: User Verified
    API-->>Client: Return JWT Access Token

    Client->>API: POST /messages (Bearer Token + Payload)
    API->>Auth: Validate JWT & Extract Claims
    Auth-->>API: Token Valid (User ID)
    API->>API: Pydantic V2 Payload Validation
    API->>DB: Async Commit to SQLModel
    DB-->>API: Row Created
    API-->>Client: 21 Created (JSON Response)
